items.title: Check In

items.title: Meet Your Budtender
items.md: When it’s your turn, a budtender will call you from the waiting area. They’ll help you choose products and answer any questions, whether you’re a first-time visitor or a returning customer.

items.title: Choose Your Items

items.title: Complete Your Purchase

blocks.heading: How to Place an Order for Dispensary Pick-Up

items.title: Build Your Order

items.q: What do I need to shop at High Society Weed Dispensary Outlet Birch Run?
items.a: To shop at our dispensary, you must present a valid government-issued ID verifying you are 21 or older. Individuals aged 18 and up with a valid medical marijuana card are also eligible to make purchases.

items.q: How can I address a defective product?
items.a: If you encounter an issue with the quality or functionality of a product, please contact us at [(989) 244-3001](tel:+19892443001) or visit the store where you made the purchase. Our team is ready to assist.

items.q: What are the payment methods at High Society?
items.a: Customers can pay with cash or debit cards. Each dispensary is equipped with an ATM for added convenience. Please check with your local store for specific payment methods.

items.q: Is it legal to transport cannabis?
items.a: Cannabis purchases are permitted in Michigan, but transporting cannabis across state lines is illegal under federal law. Please refrain from taking cannabis products out of the state.

items.q: What types of products does the dispensary carry?
items.a: Our dispensary offers a wide range of high-quality cannabis products, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Browse our menu or contact us with any specific inquiries.

items.q: Do you offer a customer rewards program?
items.a: Yes, we value our customers and offer The Society loyalty program. Earn points on every purchase and redeem them for special discounts or offers—ask our team for details.
